gbifID.description: Unique global occurrence identifier assigned by GBIF for each record.

datasetKey.description: Uniform dataset identifier linking all records to the same GBIF dataset.

occurrenceID.description: Unique iNaturalist observation URL linking to a specific Pycnoscelus indicus record.

kingdom.description: Taxonomic kingdom of the organism, consistently Animalia across all records.

phylum.description: Phylum classification for the species, consistently Arthropoda.

class.description: Taxonomic class of the organism, always Insecta.

order.description: Taxonomic order of the species, Blattodea.

family.description: Family classification for all records, consistently Blaberidae.

genus.description: Taxonomic genus of the recorded species, consistently Pycnoscelus.

species.description: Species name of the recorded organism.

infraspecificEpithet.description: No subspecies identifier is provided for any occurrence.

taxonRank.description: Taxonomic rank of the record, consistently set to species.

scientificName.description: Scientific name of the recorded species, consistently Pycnoscelus indicus (Fabricius, 1775).

verbatimScientificName.description: Scientific name of the recorded Pycnoscelus indicus occurrence.

verbatimScientificNameAuthorship.description: Authorship information for the scientific name

countryCode.description: Two‑letter ISO codes identifying the country where each occurrence was recorded.

locality.description: Locality information is unavailable for all records.

stateProvince.description: Administrative region where each occurrence was recorded, using local state or province names.

occurrenceStatus.description: Observation status confirming species presence at each recorded occurrence.

individualCount.description: Individual count of observed specimens, data missing for all records.

publishingOrgKey.description: Uniform UUID identifier linking all records to the same publishing organization.

decimalLatitude.description: Geographic latitude in decimal degrees for each occurrence record.

decimalLongitude.description: Geographic longitude in decimal degrees for each occurrence record.

coordinateUncertaintyInMeters.description: Coordinate uncertainty in meters, indicating spatial precision of occurrence records.

coordinatePrecision.description: Coordinate precision data missing for all records.

elevation.description: Elevation data missing for all records.

elevationAccuracy.description: Elevation accuracy data not provided in this dataset.

depth.description: Depth information is missing for all records.

depthAccuracy.description: Depth measurement accuracy is unavailable for all records.

eventDate.description: Observation date and time of each record.

day.description: Observation day of month when the record was logged.

month.description: Month of observation, integer values ranging from 1 to 12.

year.description: Calendar year of the occurrence record.

taxonKey.description: Taxonomic identifier for Pycnoscelus indicus, constant across all occurrence records.

speciesKey.description: Unique taxonomic identifier for Pycnoscelus indicus occurrence records.

basisOfRecord.description: Human observation is the sole basis for each occurrence record.

institutionCode.description: Data source identifier indicating records were contributed via iNaturalist platform.

collectionCode.description: All records belong to the observations collection, indicating a uniform data grouping.

catalogNumber.description: Unique numeric identifier assigned to each occurrence record.

recordNumber.description: Placeholder field with no recorded data.

identifiedBy.description: Observer names who recorded each Pycnoscelus indicus occurrence.

dateIdentified.description: Identification timestamp of each occurrence record.

license.description: License type for each record, using Creative Commons identifiers (e.g., CCBYNC40).

rightsHolder.description: Name of the person or organization holding copyright for each occurrence record.

recordedBy.description: Names of individuals who recorded each occurrence.

typeStatus.description: No data recorded for type status.

establishmentMeans.description: Establishment means data unavailable for all records.

lastInterpreted.description: Timestamp of the most recent interpretation applied to each occurrence record.

mediaType.description: Media type associated with each occurrence record.

issue.description: Data quality flags indicating coordinate rounding, continent derivation, and missing taxon identifier.

pycnoscelus_indicus.description: Occurrence records of Pycnoscelus indicus (2007‑2026) with taxonomy, location, date, and observer details.

description: Records of Pycnoscelus indicus occurrences from 2007 to 2026 for biodiversity monitoring.
